messages:
Maya Chen: Hey! Received my M2 laptop and the gear this morning — thanks folks. The USB audio hub that was supposed to include the mic preamp isn't appearing in Sound prefs (mac shows only 'Internal Microphone'). Anyone know who to ping for a replacement or quick troubleshooting? cc @josh-it :wave:

josh-it: hey @Maya Chen — welcome! :tada: Quick checks: try a different USB-C cable/port first. Can you also run and paste the output of `system_profiler SPAudioDataType`? That'll tell us if the OS sees any USB audio devices.

Maya Chen: tried both ports and a different cable, still nothing. Paste of `system_profiler SPAudioDataType` below:
```
Audio:
    Devices:
        Built-in Microphone:
            Default Input: Yes
            Input Channels: 1
            Manufacturer: Apple
    Core Audio Default Output Device: Built-in Output
```

it-bot: Ticket created: IT-12987 for Maya Chen (category: peripherals, priority: medium). Assigned to josh-it. ETA for spare processing: 3 business days.

josh-it: thanks. since system_profiler doesn't show the USB device, can you also run `system_profiler SPUSBDataType` and paste the last ~20 lines? if the hub isn't enumerating that's a USB-level issue. Also check System Settings > Privacy & Security > Microphone to ensure apps aren't blocked.

Maya Chen: pasted SPUSBDataType output (last lines) — shows only Apple internal and the USB-C hub from the dock, but not the audio interface. Also when I plug the hub in I briefly see a notification "USB device not recognized".

josh-it: that error usually means the hub isn't negotiating power or the hub's firmware isn't compatible with M-series Macs. Two options: 1) swap cables/adapters (you tried), 2) firmware or defective unit — we'll swap the unit if it keeps failing. I'll request a spare from ops now.

emma-ops: @shipping-bot can you check spare audio interfaces / USB hubs inventory in SF and send an expedited loaner to Maya (priority: new-hire onboarding)? If available, please ship same-day ground.

shipping-bot: Spare audio hub available in SF stock. Preparing expedited shipment to Maya Chen — tracking will be posted when label is created. ETA 1-2 business days.

josh-it: also as a quick workaround, you can use the laptop's built-in mic with a simple USB-C headset if you have one, or use the phone/Zoom mobile app for calls until the spare arrives.

lizzy-manager: Thanks everyone for the quick response — appreciate getting Maya up and running. Maya, LMK if you need anything else besides the loaner.

Maya Chen: awesome, thanks so much. I'll try the privacy settings you mentioned and will await the loaner. Appreciate the quick turnaround :pray: — will update ticket IT-12987 when I get the spare/tracking.
